verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an HR/EOR platform with a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-item flows (create, update and submit a single employment) and list/retrieve endpoints. Listing engagements is a read operation, not a bulk action across many items, and nothing documents batch create, update or approve endpoints or a bulk-action UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
